counterfactual_missing_items: normal findings on visual evoked potentials
lack of conclusive findings on physical examinations and imaging
decisive_items: sudden onset of painless bilateral loss of vision immediately after falling
painless bilateral loss of vision immediately after falling approximately 3 meters from a pickup truck
response.rationale: Traumatic optic neuropathy is the most likely diagnosis due to the sudden onset of bilateral vision loss after a traumatic event, despite normal visual evoked potentials. Commotio retinae is a close second due to the similar presentation of painless bilateral vision loss after a traumatic event.

rejected.why: normal neurologic examinations and lack of psychiatric history make conversion disorder less likely
concussion alone does not fully explain the bilateral vision loss
